newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong dollar, money soft on stock inflows.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong dollar, money soft on stock inflows.

text.p: * Hong Kong dollar weaker on easy money supply in interbank market, dealers said
* Influx of funds into Hong Kong stock market pushed overnight rate down to five percent from above six percent early on Monday
* Interbank market now flush with dollars, causing weakness in the Hong Kong dollar spot rate
* Dealers also said Japan called for U.S. cooperation in stabilising forex rates because currency volatility might cause Japan to sell U.S. government securities
* Hong Kong's dollar, pegged to the U.S. dollar, would be among the first Asian currencies to be affected by any sale of U.S. treasuries, which would force U.S. interest rates to rise
* Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto did not say whether Japan would actually sell U.S. treasuries if the dollar moved wildly
* Hong Kong EFN yields: 3yr 6.24 percent, 5yr 6.63 percent, 7yr 6.82 percent, one week 5.31 percent
